nodes.label: Cloud Run hosting is a feasibility design, not an implemented deployment: second-generation Cloud Run can host Rundale only with a deliberately constrained single-instance topology.
The proposed Cloud Run runtime pins minimum and maximum instances to one, keeps CPU allocated for simulation ticks, reconnects WebSockets before the 60-minute limit, and uses Gemini for inference.

Cloud persistence requires SQLite-safe shared storage, preferably GCS FUSE with DELETE journaling only after validation or Filestore as fallback, while public deployment requires an explicit authentication layer such as IAM, IAP, in-app OAuth, or Cloudflare Access.
